title: Preview: Meghan Markle: American Princess
summary: Who is Meghan Markle? Gayle King anchors a CBS News special on the future wife of Prince Harry -- the woman who went from a grade school advocate to half of a global power couple for a new era -- as told by those who know her best: her friends, teachers and co-stars. Watch Friday, April 20 at 10/9c on CBS.
